description: This file appears to be a markdown documentation source for the 'Request' class from the Playwright API. It describes the class, its methods, events, and associated concepts, with usage examples in multiple programming languages.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a network request made by a page in Playwright. It provides methods to access request details, headers, response, and related navigation or redirect information.

methods.name: allHeaders
methods.description: Returns an object with all the request HTTP headers, with header names lower-cased.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns null unless the request has failed, in which case it returns an error string.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Returns the Frame that initiated this request.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns an object with request HTTP headers, header names are lower-cased.

methods.name: headersArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all request headers, including multiple headers with same name in separate objects.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific header matching the provided name.

methods.name: isNavigationRequest
methods.description: Indicates whether this request is driving a frame's navigation.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for the request (e.g., GET, POST).

methods.name: postData
methods.description: Returns the request's post body as a string, if any.

methods.name: postDataBuffer
methods.description: Returns the request's post body in binary form, if any.

methods.name: postDataJSON
methods.description: Parses and returns the request body as JSON or form data, if applicable.

methods.name: redirectedFrom
methods.description: Returns the previous Request object if this request was redirected from another.

methods.name: redirectedTo
methods.description: Returns the new Request object if this request was redirected to another.

methods.name: resourceType
methods.description: Returns the perceived resource type, e.g., 'document', 'xhr', 'stylesheet', etc.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Returns the Response object associated with this request, or null if not available.

methods.name: serviceWorker
methods.description: Returns the Service Worker handling the request, if applicable (Chromium only).

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Provides size information about the request body, headers, and response in bytes.

methods.name: timing
methods.description: Returns timing information for the request, including start time and various phases.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the request.
